$comment: The body Paperclip's HTTP adapter pushes at POST /api/paperclip/dispatch, pinned so an image bump that moves a field fails a test before it fails in production. UNLIKE artifact-characterization.json IN THIS DIRECTORY, THIS FILE IS HAND-WRITTEN: no probe drives the adapter push, so there is nothing to regenerate with UPDATE_PAPERCLIP_SNAPSHOT=1. Read `provenance` below for exactly how much of it is measured and how much is a source read. The ids are PLACEHOLDERS; only the KEY NAMES and their nesting are the contract. Its reader is `parseDispatchBody` in src/lib/paperclip/dispatch-worker.ts, asserted in dispatch-worker.test.ts.

provenance.bodyBuiltAt: /app/server/src/adapters/http/execute.ts:13 (inside the pinned image): const body = { ...payloadTemplate, agentId: agent.id, runId, context };
provenance.payloadTemplateFrom: scripts/lib/paperclip/bootstrap-core.ts:423-434 - agentSpecs() writes payloadTemplate: { netzarAgentId: <slug> }, so netzarAgentId is ours by construction
provenance.issueIdSetAt: /app/server/src/.../heartbeat.ts:4219 (inside the pinned image): contextSnapshot.issueId = issueIdFromPayload - which is why the issue id is nested under context and not at the top level
provenance.headers: content-type: application/json plus the configured authorization (execute.ts:21-24). There is NO X-Paperclip header and NO run-id header on this direction.
provenance.howObserved: THIS BODY WAS NOT CAPTURED FROM A LOG LINE. The orchestrator logs only {reason} when it rejects a dispatch, so no line anywhere holds the bytes. What IS live evidence: 15 CloudWatch answers of 400 invalid_body to POST /api/paperclip/dispatch, with Paperclip logging "HTTP invoke failed with status 400" from adapters/http/execute.ts:30. The shape below is a read of the pinned image source that predicts exactly those 400s against the parser as it stood.
provenance.whatAChangeHereMeans: A red test on this fixture means the pinned image now pushes a different shape. Re-read execute.ts and heartbeat.ts at the NEW digest, update this file and its provenance together, and never edit one without the other.
